findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are hard-coded in plaintext within the Lambda environment variables, which are visible to anyone with read access to the Lambda configuration (console, API) or Terraform state, risking long-term credential leakage.

The Lambda function does not configure a customer-managed KMS key (kms_key_arn) for encrypting environment variables at rest, leaving sensitive data such as the embedded access keys protected only by the default service key rather than a key with tighter access control and auditability.
The function uses nodejs12.x, a Node.js runtime that has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches, increasing exposure to unpatched vulnerabilities in the language runtime.
